Name: yuiidragons redhead Penny without glasses (edited)
Author: Silverbluedew
Description:
[b]Installation:[/b]
1. Backup your default files.
2. Unzip the file.
3. Place the xnb files into your Stardew Valley folder, overwriting everything it asks you to.

[i] ﻿If you're using Steam, the default folder path is something like C:\Program Files\Steam\SteamApps\common\Stardew Valley.[/i]

[b]Uninstallation:[/b]
1. Delete the files.
2. Restore the backups you made.


All credits go to yuiidragon. Check out her original mod: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19
